name: @molcrafts/molvis
description: MolVis umbrella: 2D sketch + 3D stage (install engines explicitly for a single surface)
author: Roy Kid

scripts.check:dev-ready: L=$(mktemp); FORCE_COLOR=1 npm run dev:page > "$L" 2>&1 & P=$!; for i in $(seq 1 72); do sleep 5; grep -q "Local:" "$L" && break; done; if grep -q "Local:" "$L"; then R=0; else echo "dev never reported ready — a service readyWhen pattern likely does not match its colored output:"; tail -20 "$L"; R=1; fi; kill -INT $P 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; kill -9 $P 2>/dev/null; exit $R
scripts.build:page: npm run build:engines && npm run build -w page && rm -rf python/src/molvis/dist && mkdir -p python/src/molvis/dist && cp -r page/dist/. python/src/molvis/dist/
scripts.build:vsc-ext: npm run build:engines && npm run build -w vsc-ext
scripts.build:all: npm run build:engines && npm run build -w page && rm -rf python/src/molvis/dist && mkdir -p python/src/molvis/dist && cp -r page/dist/. python/src/molvis/dist/ && npm run build -w vsc-ext
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engines && npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:stage && npm run typecheck:sketch && npm run typecheck:plugin && npm run typecheck:page && npm run typecheck:vsc-ext
scripts.test:stage: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-stage
scripts.test:sketch: npm run build:sketch && npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-sketch
scripts.test:page: npm run build:engines && npm run test -w page
scripts.test:python: cd python && MOLVIS_SKIP_UI_BUILD=1 uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:stage && npm run test:sketch && npm run test:page && npm run test:python && npm run test:vsc-ext
scripts.check:molrs-gateway:
node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process'),f=require('fs'),F=execSync('git ls-files',{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:64e6}).split('
').filter(p=>/\.(ts|tsx|mts|cts|mjs|cjs|js|jsx)$/.test(p)).filter(p=>!p.startsWith('core/'));if(!F.length){console.error('check:molrs-gateway scanned 0 files — guard broken');process.exit(1);}const b=[];for(const p of F){let t;try{t=f.readFileSync(p,'utf8')}catch{continue}if(!t.includes('@molcrafts/molrs'))continue;t.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,'').replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g,'').split('
').forEach((l,i)=>{if(/['"\`]@molcrafts\/molrs['"\`]/.test(l))b.push(p+':'+(i+1)+': '+l.trim())});}if(b.length){console.error('only core/ may import @molcrafts/molrs:
'+b.join('
'));process.exit(1);}console.log('molrs gateway ok ('+F.length+' tracked files)');"
scripts.check:versions: node -e "const f=require('fs'),r=require('./package.json').version,ws=['.',...require('./package.json').workspaces];let b=[];for(const d of ws){const p=(d==='.'?'':d+'/')+'package.json',j=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(p));if(j.version!==r)b.push(p+': version '+j.version);for(const s of ['dependencies','peerDependencies','devDependencies'])for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(j[s]||{}))if(k.startsWith('@molcrafts/molvis')&&!/^[\\^~]?'+r+'$/.test(v)&&v.replace(/^[\\^~]/,'')!==r)b.push(p+': '+s+'.'+k+'='+v);}const py=f.readFileSync('python/pyproject.toml','utf8').match(/^version = \"([^\"]+)\"/m);if(!py)b.push('python/pyproject.toml: no version line');else if(py[1]!==r)b.push('python/pyproject.toml: version '+py[1]);if(b.length){console.error('version drift (expected '+r+'):\n'+b.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}console.log('versions in sync: '+r+' ('+ws.length+' workspaces + python)');"
